keySentence: The wolf spoke kindly and asked where she went.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The wolf asked many questions. He tricked the girl. She stopped to pick flowers. The wolf spoke kindly and asked where she went.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The wolf kept talking to Red Riding Hood sweetly. He suggested she pick flowers for her grandmother. The wolf spoke kindly and asked where she went. While she was busy picking flowers in the forest, the wolf ran ahead to Grandmother's house. Red Riding Hood did not realize the wolf's evil plan.
